en-in.intro: Check the departure airport, destination, flight number and travel date together, then use the official links below to confirm your journey.

faq.q: How do I check this flight for my travel date?
faq.a: Use the airline’s or airport’s official flight lookup with your flight number and the departure airport’s local date. Compare the airports and operating airline with your ticket; a schedule verified for one date does not confirm every departure.

faq.q: Where should I go for check-in or baggage help?
faq.a: Open the airport and airline details for the relevant stop, then check your flight on the departure screens. Check-in, ticketing offices and arrival baggage desks serve different purposes; use the contact that matches your issue.

faq.q: What evidence should I keep after a delay or cancellation?
faq.a: Keep your ticket, boarding pass, airline notices and relevant receipts. Follow the operating airline’s certificate procedure and your insurer’s document requirements; a certificate request does not by itself establish entitlement to payment.
